title: Dorayaki Carnitas Tacos
description: A fusion of Japanese dorayaki pancakes and Mexican carnitas, served in a taco shell.

ingredients.name: Dorayaki Filling
ingredients.notes: Mix of azuki bean paste and sugar

ingredients.name: Mexican Street Corn
ingredients.notes: Grilled corn with cotija cheese, chili powder, and lime juice

instructions: Warm the dorayaki pancakes according to package instructions.
Spoon the dorayaki filling onto the warmed pancakes.
Shred the carnitas into bite-sized pieces.
Grill the Mexican street corn until slightly charred.
Assemble the tacos by placing a spoonful of carnitas onto a taco shell, followed by a dollop of dorayaki filling, a sprinkle of Mexican street corn, and a slice of radish.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with a lime wedge on the side.
